# NEXUS AI Website

## Description
Stunning multi-page AI website with immersive animations, scroll effects, and interactive elements.

## Tech Stack
- HTML5, CSS3 (custom properties), Vanilla JavaScript
- GSAP + ScrollTrigger for animations
- Three.js for 3D backgrounds
- Lenis for smooth scrolling

## Architecture
- Multi-page static site
- Shared CSS/JS across all pages
- Canvas-based particle system
- Scroll-triggered animations

## Features Implemented
- Hero landing with neural network particles
- About page with timeline and parallax
- Capabilities page with 3D card effects
- Showcase gallery with masonry layout
- Contact page with animated form
- Custom cursor, smooth scroll, page transitions
- Loading screen with AI animation

## Status
✅ ALL COMPLETE - All 5 pages implemented and verified
